48.en:
Situation Report — Day 27

  • Ongoing strikes: US/Israeli airstrikes on Iranian targets continue. Iran, Hezbollah and Hamas launching missiles/rockets at Israel. Northern border active daily.
  • Pause on energy strikes: Trump announced a 10‑day pause (deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET). US says Iran requested talks; Iran denies direct talks. The prior 5‑day pause was violated hours later by strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr.
  • Northern Border (Hezbollah): Daily rocket/missile launches and IDF responses. Third consecutive week of elevated activity; expect continued intermittent sirens and local evacuations.
  • Hormuz & naval: Iran reopened the Strait selectively to Russia, India, China. US lifted its naval blockade. Commercial traffic partially restored; many flags still restricted.
  • Diplomacy & mediation: Pakistan is mediating. Tehran reportedly offered IAEA inspections of some sites. EU insists sanctions stay until a formal nuclear agreement.
  • Sanctions & finance: US issued new sanctions on Lebanese individuals/companies tied to Hezbollah. Pentagon requests roughly $80 billion for Iran war costs.
  • Tactical context: The first pause was violated quickly — pauses are fragile. Selective reopening of Hormuz raises risk of targeted maritime incidents between restricted and allowed vessels.
  • 🟢 Good News: 10‑day pause reduces immediate pressure on Iranian energy infrastructure. Some commercial traffic through Hormuz resumed. Pakistan mediation and IAEA access provide diplomatic channels.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating.
